Let  
\[
T=r^2+r+1+\frac1r+\frac1{r^2}.
\]
Then sum of roots gives \(aT=40\), and sum of reciprocals gives \(\frac Ta=10\).  
So \(T=10a\), hence
\[
aT=a(10a)=10a^2=40,
\]
so \(a^2=4\) and \(|a|=2\).

The product of the roots is
\[
\left(\frac{a}{r^2}\right)\left(\frac ar\right)(a)(ar)(ar^2)=a^5.
\]
Therefore \(|S|=|{-a^5}|=|a|^5=2^5=32\).

\[
\boxed{32}
\]
